name: Long March 10 / 10A
best_known_for: China's Moon rocket in development: two launches carry the Mengzhou crew ship and the Lanyue lander for a crewed landing before 2030
credit: Long March 10 is the rocket China is building for its crewed lunar landing, planned before 2030: one launch carries the Mengzhou crew spacecraft, another the Lanyue lander, and the two meet in lunar orbit. The single-core Long March 10A is to fly Mengzhou to Earth orbit. Engine firings ran in 2025, and on 11 February 2026 a Long March 10-series test booster flew a low-altitude flight from Wenchang, carrying a Mengzhou abort test. Its first orbital launch had not taken place by November 2026.
